item.tib: bslab gsum rnam 'byed gsal ba'i sgron me
item.coloph: bslab gsum rnam 'byed gsal sgron 'di/ snga sor bstan 'dzin rnam dag nas/ tshe gcig rnam dkar bsgrub thabs kyi/ 'jug ngogs ston zhes nan bskul dang / slar yang tshangs sras dgyes blo bas/ rtogs dka'i gnad la 'jug bde zhing / go sla'i gzhung don zab rgyas shig dgos skad spring yig pad dkar gyis/ mtshon te phebs ngor tshul rgyan pas/ bde gsal dpal gyi gsang phug tu/ lung las rigs pas phyes te bsgrigs/ bstan 'gror phan pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
